title: Check bikepacking mounts and cargo clearance
summary: Inspect frame/fork mounts and verify that attached equipment remains within documented limits and clear of moving parts.

steps.title: Inspect mounting points and surrounding structure
steps.instruction: Check frame and fork bosses for damaged threads, looseness, corrosion, cracks or movement around the insert area.
steps.why: The mounting point and surrounding structure carry accessory loads into the frame or fork.
steps.warning: Do not continue loading a damaged, loose or spinning threaded insert.
steps.check: The intended mounting interfaces show no obvious damage.

steps.title: Confirm fastener and load limits
steps.instruction: Check the actual frame/fork and accessory instructions for permitted mounting positions, fastener length, torque and load. Use the lowest applicable limit.
steps.why: The number of bolts or size of an accessory does not reveal the structure's allowable load.
steps.warning: Never infer fork or frame cargo capacity from appearance alone.
steps.check: The intended accessory and cargo remain within the documented limits of every involved component.

steps.title: Check wheel, brake and steering clearance
steps.instruction: Secure bags, straps and cages so nothing can enter a tire, wheel, brake rotor/caliper, drivetrain or steering path. Turn the handlebar through its useful range and compress flexible bags by hand to check movement.
steps.why: Soft luggage can shift far more than a rigid component under vibration or steering.
steps.warning: Loose straps or bags near wheels and brakes can create an immediate control hazard.
steps.check: Mounted equipment stays clear of steering and all moving components.

steps.title: Perform a controlled loaded handling check
steps.instruction: Push and then ride the loaded bicycle slowly in a safe area. Confirm steering, braking and load retention remain predictable before normal riding.
steps.why: Cargo changes mass distribution and can alter steering and braking behavior even when every mount is structurally sound.
steps.warning: Stop and change the setup if luggage shifts or handling is unstable.
steps.check: The loaded bicycle remains predictable during the controlled check.
